entry.title: How to perform credit approval for blocked outbound deliveries in release 2608
entry.content:
Dear SAP Support Team,

We encountered an issue that the sales document cannot be approved and released after credit unfreezing. I performed credit test in the customizing system following the latest official test script for scope item 2608.

Per the script, the credit release Fiori app should be Manage Documented Credit Decision. However, after the 2608 version upgrade, this app is no longer available, and the corresponding business catalog ID SAP FIN BC CR CASES PC has also been removed.

I tried to use the new app Manage Credit Cases to release the document instead. But the approval button is greyed out and not clickable.

Please help investigate and advise the resolution.

entry.title: Clarification on Asset Settlement Transaction Type 331 vs 336 in S/4HANA Public Cloud
entry.content:
Hello SAP Support Team,

We would like clarification regarding the determination of asset transaction types during settlement from an investment measure (WBS Element) to a fixed asset in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.

Scenario:

  • Costs were collected on a WBS Element and subsequently settled to a fixed asset.
  • The settlement posted to the asset using Transaction Type 331 (Acquisition Transfer from Investment Measure - Prior Year Acquisition).
  • As a result, the amount is reported under the Transfer category in Asset Accounting reports rather than under Additions/Acquisitions.
  • There was no actual asset transfer or disposal. The posting represents capitalization of investment costs to the asset.

Business Requirement: For audit and reporting purposes, the business would prefer such capitalizations to be reported under Additions rather than Transfers, where appropriate.

Questions:

  1. Is the determination of transaction type 331 vs 336 standard system behavior based on the fiscal year of the underlying costs?
  2. Is there any configuration, SSCUI, expert configuration, or extensibility option available in S/4HANA Public Cloud to derive 336 (Current-Year Acquisition) instead of 331 during settlement?
  3. If not configurable, what is SAP's recommended approach to report these postings as capital additions for audit purposes?

Example Asset: 20003751

We appreciate your guidance on the standard SAP behavior and any available options.

Thank you.

entry.title: Keep manual “Identification” value in payment media management after activating J78
entry.content:
Dear community;

We are working with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. Until now, in the Manage Automatic Payments app, users created a payment parameter and manually filled in the “Identification” field with free text (date, currency, etc.) to identify the payment run. That text was then carried over to the payment media management app, where it was used to recognize it.

After activating scope item J78 (Advanced Cash Operations), what is entered in the parameter no longer reaches the payment media management app, and the field is now populated automatically with a value generated by SAP. Users have lost traceability of their payment runs.

Our questions are:

  1. Is there any configuration or parameter to deactivate the automatic population of this field by SAP and keep the text entered by the user?
  2. If not, is there a standard way to fill in a field when creating the payment proposal (reference, free text or other) so that it is visible later in the payment media management app?

Any experience or recommendation would be appreciated.

Thanks in advance.

entry.title: S/4HANA Cloud Public–Cost deferral (EBRR) on non-billable service order items linked to a contract
entry.content:
Hello experts,

we are implementing SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition (Service Order Management 3D2, Service Contract Management 3MO, Event-Based Revenue Recognition – Service Documents 3M3). We are trying to solve a cost deferral requirement and would appreciate any advice or experience.

Business context

Our customer performs cyclic and extraordinary maintenance on machines.

  • Billing is done from the service contract using an ad-hoc billing plan, typically a down payment (e.g. 75%) when work is completed, and the final invoice in the following quarter.
  • Service orders are used only to collect costs: stock materials issued (service part items), purchased materials/services, and internal labor hours coming from an external system. The service order items are not billable and the service orders reference the service contract.

Requirement

Costs posted on the service orders must not be recognized immediately. They must be deferred and recognized only at final billing, together with the related revenue. In other words, we need costs and revenue to be matched: costs on the service order, revenue on the referenced contract.

What we observe in the standard

  1. Non-billable service order items: costs are recognized immediately. We set the recognition key CCOCC (Completed Contract – Service Order) manually on the non-billable item in the app Revenue Recognition (Event-Based) – Service Documents before the goods issue. The goods issue cost was still recognized immediately (no COS adjustment, no Deferred COS).
  2. Key derivation: in the SSCUI Derivation of Recognition Key for Service Documents (102968) we cannot enter the non-billable item category. It seems only billing-relevant item categories are allowed.
  3. Billable item with zero value (workaround): if we add a billable item with value 0 and CCOCC, the deferral works as expected: Actual Cost 135, COS Adjustment –135, Deferred COS 135. However:
    • the job Schedule Technical Completion for Financial Close does not set TECO, with the warning: “Invoices must be created for the item and posted to financial accounting. Status of the account assignment object stays Released.”
    • this item will never be invoiced (billing is done from the contract), so the costs would remain deferred indefinitely;
    • creating a zero-value invoice just to reach TECO is not acceptable for fiscal reasons (Italian e-invoicing / SdI, tax postings, fiscal numbering).
  4. Financial hierarchy with service contract as root item: this seems to be exactly the intended solution, since service order costs are collected on the contract item where revenue is. However, as far as we understand it requires a dedicated contract item category with the flag “Root Item in Financial Hierarchy”. We cannot create new item categories in our Public Cloud tenant, and we are not sure whether the scenario is available in Public Cloud at all.

Questions

  1. Is there a standard way in S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition to defer costs on non-billable service order items referencing a billable service contract, and recognize them when the contract is billed?
  2. Is the financial hierarchy with service contract item as root item available in Public Cloud? If so, is there an SAP-delivered contract item category with the root flag, or another way to activate it?
  3. If we keep a billable item that will never be invoiced, is there any standard way to set TECO on it (e.g. a billing status, rejection reason or other setting) so that EBRR releases the deferred costs at period-end closing, without issuing an invoice?
  4. Has anyone faced a similar scenario (contract billing + service order cost collection + cost deferral) in Public Cloud, and how did you solve it?

Thank you in advance for any input!

SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

entry.title: #CoE#GB Unexpected Quantity Change After Mass Update of Purchasing Info Records
entry.content:
Dear Experts,

We have encountered an issue while using the Mass Changes to Purchasing Info Records app and would appreciate your assistance in understanding the system behavior.

During the upload process, the value maintained in the upload file was:

  • Quantity: 100
  • Price: 1,105

After the upload was completed, the Purchasing Info Record was updated in the system as:

  • Quantity: 10
  • Price: 1,105

The quantity appears to have been changed from 100 to 10 automatically, while the price remained unchanged.

We have also reviewed the change logs and could not find any evidence that the record was modified by another user after the upload was completed.

Could you please help clarify the following points?

  1. Is there any standard SAP logic that could automatically convert or adjust the quantity during the upload process?
  2. Are there any unit of measure conversions, scale settings, or data interpretation rules that may cause the uploaded quantity of 100 to be stored as 10?
  3. Is this expected system behavior or a potential defect?
  4. Are there any logs, technical traces, or application logs that we can review to identify what happened during the upload?

The customer is concerned about the discrepancy between the uploaded data and the final result stored in the system. Therefore, we would appreciate your prompt investigation and clarification.

Thank you for your support.

Kind regards,

Ashley Hung

entry.title: Alternative Approach for Mass Upload of Recurring Journal Entry Templates in SAP S/4HANA Public Clou
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

I am looking for guidance on a requirement in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud related to the creation of recurring journal entries at scale.

Business Requirement

We need to mass create/upload a large number of recurring journal entry templates in the system. The objective is to avoid manual creation of each recurring journal entry through the Fiori application Manage Recurring Journal Entries app (F1598)  due to the high volume involved.

After reviewing the available standard applications and APIs, we have encountered the following limitations:

  1. The Manage Recurring Journal Entries Fiori application does not appear to provide any standard Excel upload / mass upload capability for creating recurring journal entries.

  2. The application is based on the OData service/API: FAC_RECURRING_ACCOUNTING_DOC_SRV However, this service appears to be an unreleased API and therefore cannot be consumed for custom development or integrations in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, where only released APIs are supported.


Could the community please suggest a supported approach in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud for:

A. Mass creation of recurring journal entries

B. Mass upload of recurring journal entry templates

C. Available released APIs, migration objects, or public-cloud-compliant integration options

D. Recommended best practices followed by other customers facing similar requirements

Has anyone successfully implemented a scalable solution for this scenario in SAP Public Cloud?Any guidance, recommendations, or alternative approaches would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance for your support.

entry.title: StatusCode is ERROR for SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, France, S/4HANA Public cloud
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

I am an SAP consultant currently preparing for a go-live of SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) in November.

I am implementing SAP DRC for France electronic invoicing in an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

As part of our testing, we are using two company codes within the same SAP S/4HANA Cloud tenant to test both outgoing customer invoices and incoming supplier invoices.

The outgoing customer invoice process is working successfully. However, after receiving an incoming supplier invoice, we encounter the following error when clicking the Accept button in the Manage Electronic Documents app.

Error Code:
EDOCUMENT_FR_INV-084

Error Message:
Unable to find the receiver registration ID or status is not SUCCESS. StatusCode is ERROR

 

While investigating this issue, I found SAP KBA 3793041, which led me to review SAP Notes/KBA 3772370 and 3713986.

However, since we are using SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, I am unsure whether these SAP Notes are applicable to our environment and whether any manual implementation is required or supported.

I would appreciate your guidance on the following questions:

1. What is the recommended resolution for error EDOCUMENT_FR_INV-084 when accepting an incoming France supplier invoice? Are there any specific configuration settings or prerequisites that should be checked?

2. For implementing France electronic invoicing and electronic reporting via an Approved Platform (PA) using SAP DRC, are SAP Notes 3772370 and 3713986 sufficient, or are there any other mandatory SAP Notes that need to be implemented?

3. How are SAP Notes applied in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition? Is manual SAP Note implementation supported, or are the relevant corrections delivered automatically through SAP-managed software updates?

 

Thank you in advance for your support.

Best regards

entry.content:

For a standard invoice, I enter the Service Rendered Date in VF01, and this date is correctly transferred to the accounting document as the Tax Fulfilment Date and Tax Reporting Date.
